@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) {
	body:not(.updating-theme) .wp-block-button__link {
		transition: background-color .15s linear, border-color .15s linear;
	}
}

.wp-block-button.is-style-outline > .wp-block-button__link:not(.has-text-color, .has-background):hover {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-4 );
	border-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-4 );
}


/*
 * Block style: Arrow Right
 */

:root [class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link {
	align-items: center;
	border: none;
	color: inherit;
	background-color: transparent;
	display: inline-flex;
	font-weight: 400;
	padding: 0;
}

[class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link:hover {
	text-decoration: underline;
}

[class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link:before,
[class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link:after {
	background-color: currentColor;
	display: block;
	height: 1em;
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
	mask-size: cover;
	width: 1em;
}

.is-style-outset-arrow-left .wp-block-button__link:before {
	content: "";
	margin-right: .5em;
	mask-image: var(--icon-arrow-left-url);
}

.is-style-outset-arrow-right .wp-block-button__link:after {
	content: "";
	margin-left: .5em;
	mask-image: var(--icon-arrow-right-url);
}

/*
 * Block style: Theme Switch
 */

:root .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link {
	border: none;
	border-radius: 999px;
	display: block;
	height: 32px;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	text-indent: -99999px;
	width: 56px;
}

html:not([data-theme="dark"]) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link {
	box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 4px rgba(var(--contrast-rgb), .05);
}

.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before,
.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
		left: 2px;
		top: 2px;
}

@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) {
	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before,
	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
		transition: transform .25s ease;
	}
}

.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--base-2 );
	border-radius: 50%;
	height: 28px;
	width: 28px;
}

html:not([data-theme="dark"]) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before {
	box-shadow: 0px 0px 4px rgba(var(--contrast-rgb), .05);
}

.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast );
	mask-image: var( --icon-sun-url );
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
	height: 16px;
	margin: 6px 0 0 6px;
	width: 16px;
}

/* Hover */

@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) and ( hover: hover ) {

	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:before,
	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:after {
		transform: translateX( 4px ) rotate( 22.5deg );
	}

	[data-theme="dark"] body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:before,
	[data-theme="dark"] body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:after {
		transform: translateX( 20px ) rotate( -22.5deg );
	}

}

/* Active */

[data-theme="dark"] .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before,
[data-theme="dark"] .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	transform: translateX( 24px );
}

[data-theme="dark"] .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	mask-image: var( --icon-moon-url );
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
}

<style id="outset-query-inline-css">
/*
 * Post Type: Gear
 */

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--base-2 );
	border: 1px solid var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-4 );
	border-radius: 8px;
}

.gear-categories .is-style-outset-post-template-boxed:has(.gear-status-retired) {
	background: transparent;
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed li:first-child > div {
	border-top: none;
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .wp-block-post {
	position: relative;
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .wp-block-post-title a:before {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-2 );
	content: "";
	height: 1em;
	mask-image: var(--icon-arrow-right-url);
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
	position: absolute;
		right: 1em;
		top: calc( 50% - .5em );
	transition: transform .2s linear;
	width: 1em;
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .wp-block-post-title a:hover:before,
.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .wp-block-post-title a:focus:before {
	transform: translateX( .25em );
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .wp-block-post-title a:after {
	content: "";
	inset: 0;
	position: absolute;
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .wp-block-post-title:has( > .boxed-title-note ) {
	align-items: center;
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.is-style-outset-post-template-boxed .boxed-title-note {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-4 );
	border-radius: 999px;
	flex-shrink: 0;
	font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--x-small);
	height: calc( var(--wp--preset--font-size--small) * 1.5 );
	margin: 0 0 0 1em;
	padding: 1px 10px 0 10px;
}

.gear-categories details {
	margin-top: 0;
}

.gear-categories details:not(:has( .wp-block-post-template > li )),
.gear-more-in:not(:has( li )),
.tutorial-more-in:not(:has( li )) {
	display: none;
}

.gear-categories summary {
	color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-2 );
	padding: var( --wp--preset--spacing--30 ) var( --wp--preset--spacing--30 ) var( --wp--preset--spacing--30 ) calc( 1px + var( --wp--preset--spacing--30 ) + 44px + var( --wp--preset--spacing--40 ) );
	position: relative;
}

.gear-categories summary:after {
	background-color: currentColor;
	content: "";
	height: 1em;
	mask-image: var( --icon-plus-url );
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
	mask-size: contain;
	mask-position: center;
	position: absolute;
		left: calc( var( --wp--preset--spacing--30 ) + 1px );
		top: calc( 50% - .5em );
	transition: transform .2s linear;
	width: 44px;
}

.gear-categories details[open] summary:after {
	transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.gear-categories summary:hover {
	text-decoration: underline;
}

/*
 * Post Type: Themes
 */

/* Block Themes */

/*
 * Larger row gap than the block's gap setting. The gap is set as a single value on the block, since
 * WordPress builds invalid CSS for responsive grids with separate row and column gaps.
 */
.wp-block-query.block-themes .wp-block-post-template-is-layout-grid {
	row-gap: var( --wp--preset--spacing--70 );
}

.wp-block-query.block-themes .wp-block-post-featured-image {
	margin-bottom: clamp( 8px, 1.2vw, 12px );
}

.wp-block-query.block-themes .wp-block-post-featured-image img {
	border-radius: clamp( 4px, .4vw, 8px );
}

/* Classic Themes */

.wp-block-query.classic-themes {
	position: relative;
}

.wp-block-query.classic-themes:before {
	background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--base-2);
	content: "";
	display: block;
	height: 2px;
	position: absolute;
		left: 0;
		right: 0;
		top: 0;
	z-index: 1;
}
/*# sourceURL=https://andersnoren.se/wp-content/themes/andersnoren-se-outset/assets/css/blocks/query.css */

@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) {
	body:not(.updating-theme) .wp-block-button__link {
		transition: background-color .15s linear, border-color .15s linear;
	}
}

.wp-block-button.is-style-outline > .wp-block-button__link:not(.has-text-color, .has-background):hover {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-4 );
	border-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast-4 );
}


/*
 * Block style: Arrow Right
 */

:root [class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link {
	align-items: center;
	border: none;
	color: inherit;
	background-color: transparent;
	display: inline-flex;
	font-weight: 400;
	padding: 0;
}

[class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link:hover {
	text-decoration: underline;
}

[class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link:before,
[class*="is-style-outset-arrow-"] .wp-block-button__link:after {
	background-color: currentColor;
	display: block;
	height: 1em;
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
	mask-size: cover;
	width: 1em;
}

.is-style-outset-arrow-left .wp-block-button__link:before {
	content: "";
	margin-right: .5em;
	mask-image: var(--icon-arrow-left-url);
}

.is-style-outset-arrow-right .wp-block-button__link:after {
	content: "";
	margin-left: .5em;
	mask-image: var(--icon-arrow-right-url);
}

/*
 * Block style: Theme Switch
 */

:root .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link {
	border: none;
	border-radius: 999px;
	display: block;
	height: 32px;
	padding: 0;
	position: relative;
	text-indent: -99999px;
	width: 56px;
}

html:not([data-theme="dark"]) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link {
	box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 4px rgba(var(--contrast-rgb), .05);
}

.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before,
.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
		left: 2px;
		top: 2px;
}

@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) {
	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before,
	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
		transition: transform .25s ease;
	}
}

.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--base-2 );
	border-radius: 50%;
	height: 28px;
	width: 28px;
}

html:not([data-theme="dark"]) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before {
	box-shadow: 0px 0px 4px rgba(var(--contrast-rgb), .05);
}

.is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	background-color: var( --wp--preset--color--contrast );
	mask-image: var( --icon-sun-url );
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
	height: 16px;
	margin: 6px 0 0 6px;
	width: 16px;
}

/* Hover */

@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference ) and ( hover: hover ) {

	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:before,
	body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:after {
		transform: translateX( 4px ) rotate( 22.5deg );
	}

	[data-theme="dark"] body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:before,
	[data-theme="dark"] body:not(.updating-theme) .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:hover:after {
		transform: translateX( 20px ) rotate( -22.5deg );
	}

}

/* Active */

[data-theme="dark"] .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:before,
[data-theme="dark"] .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	transform: translateX( 24px );
}

[data-theme="dark"] .is-style-outset-theme-switcher .wp-block-button__link:after {
	mask-image: var( --icon-moon-url );
	mask-repeat: no-repeat;
}
